name: radial-progress
title: Radial progress
description: A radial progress ring for one ratio against a limit, with the unfilled track in a lighter step of the same colour.

Radial progress: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { RadialProgress } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/radial-progress";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
